message:
I am thinking...: The prebuilt mruby binary requires GLIBC_2.38 but the system has 2.36. So I can't run the prebuilt binary. I need to build mruby myself with the local gcc/glibc.

Let me build mruby from source with ASAN using gcc. I have:
- gcc 12.2.0
- y.tab.c (pre-generated bison output) — so no bison needed
- mrblib.c (pre-generated) in build/host/mrblib/mrblib.c
- presym (pre-generated) in build/host/presym

I need to figure out the full list of source files and compile flags. This is essentially replicating the mruby build manually.

Let me look at the build/host/src/*.d dependency files — they contain the exact compile commands and flags used! That's gold. Let me check one.
